entry.title: Route planning, now with live traffic
entry.summary:
Route planning now reroutes trucks around live traffic before a delivery runs late, for every lane.

Turn it on in Settings.

entry.title: Exchanges suggest the next size up
entry.summary:
When a shopper sends something back for fit, Parcelpine now offers the next size up before the refund.

It also works for colors.

entry.title: Proof of delivery photos
entry.summary: Drivers can attach a photo at the door, and customers see it in the tracking link within a minute.
